text: Single-dimension improvements (even +42% observability) insufficient to cross composite threshold without multi-dimension bundling
Targeting single metric optimization without addressing bottlenecks in other weighted dimensions

Worktree factory eval has phantom penalty from test/coverage detection showing 'Not detected' at 0.5 instead of 1.0, ~0.14 score impact. Root cause: factory Python env lacks pytest/coverage tools. Config fixes are harmless but insufficient.
Multi-dimension bundling (type_check + observability) is more resilient and crosses composite threshold when single dimensions fail
Config-only fixes (pytest.ini) cannot bridge factory eval infrastructure gap when eval environment lacks the tool entirely

FEEC strategy (FIX → EXPLOIT → EXPLORE → COMPRESS) works: bundle a targeted fix with an exploit dimension to cross composite threshold naturally. Exp 4: conflict detection fix + observability exploit crossed 0.6 without forcing.
Observability dimension is high-leverage: +0.044 from core module instrumentation. Pattern: one structlog per module boundary (board, agents, loop, runner).
Cycle 2 trajectory confirms strategy: baseline 0.543 → cycle 1 end 0.586 → cycle 2 end 0.607. Consistent +0.02–0.04 per experiment when bundled; isolated improvements plateau.
